name: Congenital Mitral Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Congenital Mitral Valve Malformation Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Morphological abnormalities of the mitral valve apparatus including leaflet thickening, clefts, or hypoplasia
Echocardiographic evidence of mitral valve dysfunction such as regurgitation or stenosis
Presence of clinical signs consistent with mitral valve disease including heart murmur and signs of congestive heart failure

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of morphological mitral valve abnormalities on imaging plus echocardiographic evidence of valve dysfunction
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on echocardiographic and anatomical findings; genetic testing may support but is not definitive.

searchTerms: mitral valve backflow present at birth

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to decreased cardiac output
searchTerms: fatigue due to low cardiac output

rare.symptomName: Hemoptysis due to pulmonary venous hypertension

hemoptysis due to pulmonary venous high pressure
blood in sputum from lung vein problems

rare.symptomName: Cyanosis secondary to severe mitral stenosis
searchTerms: blue skin from severe mitral narrowing
low oxygen due to mitral valve blockage
cyanosis caused by mitral valve stenosis

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiography showing mitral valve leaflet abnormalities and regurgitation or stenosis
Cardiac MRI for detailed valve anatomy and function
Chest X-ray showing left atrial enlargement and pulmonary congestion
genetic: Possible mutations in genes related to cardiac valve development (e.g., TBX5, NOTCH1) though not definitive
other: Electrocardiogram showing left atrial enlargement or arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Late systolic murmur with mid-systolic click

redFlags: Severe mitral regurgitation causing acute heart failure
references: Moss and Adams' Heart Disease in Infants, Children, and Adolescents, 9th Edition
American Heart Association Guidelines on Congenital Heart Disease
